limitations: The two first-order formulas require exact specified cap-height sequences. No uniform-in-k theorem, growing-graph limit, independent audit, or unconditional historical priority is asserted.
scientific_integrity: The theorem uses exact spherical-cap conditioning, fixed graph order and explicitly identified asymptotic regimes; finite numerical experiments are corroborative, not an infinite-dimensional proof.
title: A fourth-root cap transition and a first-order motif law for random spherical right-angle graphs
